envelope.description: Re-point the plugin's shared-transport imports onto the adapter (mechanical, no chat behavior change)

body.title: Re-point the plugin's shared-transport imports onto the adapter (mechanical, no chat behavior change)
body.summary: vscode-plugin/src/chat/cli-adapter.ts's type-only VibeCatalogModel import moves from src/shared/vibe-session.js to the adapter module (zero behavior change, confirmed no runtime transport call in this file). vscode-plugin/src/chat/vibe-session-process.ts's imports (runVerifiedVibeTurn, VibeTurnError, VibeCatalogModel, VibeTurnOptions) move to the adapter's equivalents; runVibeChatJob's turn call becomes a call to the adapter's runVibeTurn with the identical options object -- no mapper, event-mapping or worker-lifecycle change (that is a later Story, s3).
acceptanceChecks: cli-adapter.ts imports VibeCatalogModel from the adapter module, not vibe-session.js, with no other change to that file
vibe-session-process.ts imports runVerifiedVibeTurn/VibeTurnError/VibeCatalogModel/VibeTurnOptions equivalents from the adapter module only
runVibeChatJob's turn call is the adapter's runVibeTurn, given the SAME VibeTurnOptions-shaped object the worker already builds
the chat worker's observable behavior is unchanged -- the same rows are written to the same line protocol (integration test against the real adapter, no transport)

tests.name: cli-adapter.ts imports VibeCatalogModel from the adapter module, not vibe-session.js
vscode-plugin/src/chat/vibe-session-process.ts runVibeChatJob through the adapter turn entry — the chat worker's observable behavior is unchanged, same rows to the same line protocol
